projects.name: In this project cargo related products are managed by warehouse staff. There are 3  modules, acceptance
details: breakdown and buildup.
The buildup is done by warehouse agents, who need to previously load the records in the system to ensure
anything built up is OK to go by all standards. Warehouse agents in the smart warehouse to perform the
breakdown accordingly. Warehouse personnel will then initiate the process of handling the freight
according to the breakdown instructions prepared by the office  agents during flight preparation. When
consolidations (with multiple HWBs) are indicated to be broken down by HWB, the warehouse agent
will enter the piece count at each location for each HWB.
Programming skill: -HTML5, CSS3, Entity Framework, JSON, C#.Net and MVC, Linq, web API, SQL
Server, .Net core, Angular, Azure function, Azure app service.
Tools and Technology: -Visual Studio, SQL Server, Git, Azure DevOps. (CI/CD)
Responsibilities: - • Agile development methodology, ensuring design compliance with technical requirements for
Availability, Capacity, Performance, and Security.
• Developing project plans, estimating time requirements, establishing deadlines, monitoring
milestones, tracking project lifecycle, reporting issues that impact project progress to both client &
top managements.
• Developed and maintained web applications using C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, and
Web API and Angular.
• Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core Web API.
• Developed reusable and scalable application components using Object-Oriented Programming
(OOP) and SOLID principles.
• Worked with Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core for database connectivity, ORM, and
CRUD operations.
• Implemented Azure cloud services for application hosting, configuration, storage, monitoring, and
deployment.
• Worked with Azure App Service, Azure SQL Database, Azure Storage, Azure Key Vault, and
Application Insights as required by the application architecture.
• Designed and optimized SQL Server queries, stored procedures, views, and database objects.
• Implemented LINQ queries for efficient data manipulation and business logic.
• Implemented secure authentication and authorization using JWT.
• Implemented application-level validations, exception handling, logging, and performance
improvements.
• Designed responsive and reusable UI components using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and
Bootstrap.
• Used Git for source-code management and followed branching and pull-request practices.
• Configured and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, including automated build,
testing, and deployment processes.

Project Role: Sr. Software Engineer.
Project: - Warehouse System.
Client: - Worldwide Flight Services.

periods.label: In this project cargo related products are managed by warehouse staff. There are 3  modules, acceptance

entry.text: Project Description: -
In this project cargo related products are managed by warehouse staff. There are 3  modules, acceptance
breakdown and buildup.
The buildup is done by warehouse agents, who need to previously load the records in the system to ensure
anything built up is OK to go by all standards. Warehouse agents in the smart warehouse to perform the
breakdown accordingly. Warehouse personnel will then initiate the process of handling the freight
according to the breakdown instructions prepared by the office  agents during flight preparation. When
consolidations (with multiple HWBs) are indicated to be broken down by HWB, the warehouse agent
will enter the piece count at each location for each HWB.
Programming skill: -HTML5, CSS3, Entity Framework, JSON, C#.Net and MVC, Linq, web API, SQL
Server, .Net core, Angular, Azure function, Azure app service.
Tools and Technology: -Visual Studio, SQL Server, Git, Azure DevOps. (CI/CD)
Responsibilities: -
• Agile development methodology, ensuring design compliance with technical requirements for
Availability, Capacity, Performance, and Security.
• Developing project plans, estimating time requirements, establishing deadlines, monitoring
milestones, tracking project lifecycle, reporting issues that impact project progress to both client &
top managements.
• Developed and maintained web applications using C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, and
Web API and Angular.
• Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core Web API.
• Developed reusable and scalable application components using Object-Oriented Programming
(OOP) and SOLID principles.
• Worked with Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core for database connectivity, ORM, and
CRUD operations.
• Implemented Azure cloud services for application hosting, configuration, storage, monitoring, and
deployment.
• Worked with Azure App Service, Azure SQL Database, Azure Storage, Azure Key Vault, and
Application Insights as required by the application architecture.
• Designed and optimized SQL Server queries, stored procedures, views, and database objects.
• Implemented LINQ queries for efficient data manipulation and business logic.
• Implemented secure authentication and authorization using JWT.
• Implemented application-level validations, exception handling, logging, and performance
improvements.
• Designed responsive and reusable UI components using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and
Bootstrap.
• Used Git for source-code management and followed branching and pull-request practices.
• Configured and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, including automated build,
testing, and deployment processes.
